derived.$note: Trend: least-squares slope over 35 observed years (1990-2024) from DS-35, compared against the DS-06-NDC-LATEST target of 6.527 MtCO₂e by 2035. The document states the percentage; the level it is applied to comes from DS-35, on DS-35's inventory scope, which is not necessarily the document's.
derived.$reason: observed emissions are rising by 0.10 MtCO₂e/yr while the target requires a fall of 0.34 MtCO₂e/yr. No multiple of the current trend reaches it, so no finite gap factor is reported.

verdict.text: Armenia pledges a 44% reduction by 2035 against 1990 baseline (unconditional), and 52% conditional. The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-12-31. The document's condition, in its own words: "44% GHG reduction from 1990 levels by 2035 (≈11 404 Gg CO₂ eq. reduced) ● Conditional Target: 52% GHG reduction from 1990 levels by 2035 (≈13 516 Gg CO₂ eq. reduced) ● ● 1990 emissions: Derived from First National Communication Historical Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and projection: International Monetary Fund World Economic Outlook April 2025 and Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia (ARMSTAT) Population: ARMSTAT and UNFPA Energy and emissions data: Armenia's energy balance reports, Biennial update report (BUR) 3, LT-LEDS ● ● The baseline year (1990) value may be subject to" 50 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (4). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 12.6 MtCO₂e, DS-35 10.3 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. The target is not reached on the observed trend. Both figures are on DS-35's inventory: the document's percentage applied to DS-35's 1990 level, not the document's own. It submitted BTR1. 5 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 53.2 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: Total aggregate emissions between 2015 and 2050 will be equal to 633 million tCO2eq, and that the country will strive to achieve ecosystem neutral GHG emissions in 2050 (equivalent to 2.07 tons/per capita per annum) with international support. It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.71°C under SSP1-2.6 to +6.13°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
